theme: Enrage, damage triggers and damage modifiers
reuse: 'Whenever this creature is dealt damage' (enrage) precedents: wrathful_raptors.go, ripjaw_raptor.go; fight: fight_triggers.go / fight_spells.go; damage doubling / 'prevent half, rounded up': game/multiply_damage.go, prevent_next_from_source.go, dark_sphere.go; 'prevent all but 1': hyperion_supreme_hero.go; Wayta's doubler ('being dealt damage causes a triggered ability ... to trigger') is a TriggerDoubler with Applies on the damage event (trigger_doubling.go, panharmonicon.go; docs 'Adding a trigger doubler') — no new engine; 'draw that many cards' when dealt damage is shared by Body of Knowledge and Illusory Ambusher (one helper, both here).
